section.content: The utility model provides a biological gene storage device, which relates to the technical field of biological gene storage and comprises a device shell, wherein a top cover is arranged above the device shell, the top end of the top cover is fixedly connected with a handle, the left side of the top cover is hinged with a hinge, a telescopic plate is arranged below the top cover, the right side above the device shell is provided with a clamping groove, the side of a storage tube is fixedly connected with a connecting rod, a temperature sensor is arranged below an inner frame, the two sides of the inner frame are fixedly connected with heat preservation layers, because the prior device has poor heat preservation capability after the sample is stored, the prior device is easy to shake and cause pollution when being transferred after the sample is taken, the model of the sample test tube after sampling is not stored fully, a spacing area is left between the limiting grooves on the inner cavity of the shell of the device, through keeping warm at interval zone spare with the heat preservation setting, the expansion plate expandes and seals the internal frame, prevents that inside temperature from running off, makes its test tube sample put into the storage tube after heat preservation ability stronger.

本实用新型提供了一种生物基因保存装置，涉及生物基因储存技术领域，本实用新型包括装置外壳，装置外壳上方设置有顶盖，顶盖顶端固定连接有把手，顶盖左侧铰接有铰链，顶盖下方设置有伸缩板，装置外壳上方右侧开设有卡槽，储存管侧方固定连接有连接杆，内框架下方设置有温度传感器，内框架两侧固定连接有保温层，由于现有的设备样本储存后保温能力差，在取样后转移时容易晃动造成污染，对取样后的样本试管型号储存不够全面，装置外壳内腔上限位槽之间留有间隔区域，通过将保温层设置在间隔区域件进行保温，伸缩板展开将内框架进行封闭，防止内部温度流失，使其试管样本放入储存管内后保温能力更强。

Biological gene save setTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological gene storage, in particular to a biological gene storage device.

Background

With the development of biotechnology, the biological gene technology is more and more mature, people often can extract and detect biological samples, and a storage device is needed after the biological samples are extracted, and the biological sample storage device is usually needed to be stored at a specific temperature and needs to be transferred to a specific detection area for detection after the samples are extracted and stored.

But present sampling equipment is poor to sample storage back heat preservation ability, rocks easily when shifting after the sample and causes the pollution, stores the not comprehensive scheduling problem inadequately to the sample test tube model after the sample, greatly reduced the practicality of equipment.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to solve the problems that the prior art has poor heat preservation capability after sample storage, is easy to shake and pollute during transfer after sampling, and can not store the model of a sample test tube completely.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme:

the utility model provides a biological gene save set, includes the device shell, device shell top is provided with the top cap, top cap top fixedly connected with handle, the top cap left side articulates there is the hinge, the top cap below is provided with the expansion plate, the draw-in groove has been seted up on device shell top right side, device shell bottom fixedly connected with vibration damping mount, device shell inner chamber is provided with the internal frame, be provided with the holding tube in the internal frame, holding tube side fixedly connected with connecting rod, the internal frame below is provided with temperature sensor, internal frame both sides fixedly connected with heat preservation.

Preferably, a circular groove is formed in the left side of the clamping groove, the right side end of the expansion plate is embedded in the circular groove, and the expansion plate is arranged in a multi-section mode.

Preferably, top cap right side bottom is provided with the buckle, the buckle inserts in the draw-in groove, and swing joint has in the draw-in groove to insert incidentally.

Preferably, the side wall of the inner cavity of the device shell is provided with a limiting groove, the side end of the inner frame is fixedly connected with a plug board, and the plug board is embedded in the limiting groove.

Preferably, a spacing area is reserved between the upper part and the lower part of a limiting groove on the side wall of the inner cavity of the shell of the device, and the heat insulation layer is embedded in the spacing area.

Preferably, a sliding edge is arranged above the storage tube, and the sliding edge is arranged in a smooth manner and surrounds the opening side of the storage tube.

Preferably, the bottom of the inner frame and the bottom of the storage pipe are both provided with heat conducting holes.

Preferably, the side wall of the inner cavity of the storage tube is fixedly connected with a spring, the side end of the spring is fixedly connected with clamping plates, and the clamping plates are provided with two groups on the side wall of the inner cavity of the storage tube.

Has the advantages that:

this kind of biological gene save set is provided with two sets of cardboards from top to bottom through being provided with on the storage tube inner chamber, make its model test tube sample at different length put into the back, carry on spacingly with its card in the storage tube through the cardboard of difference in height, the practicality of equipment storage sample has been strengthened, the storage tube opening outside is provided with the slick line, when the device removes, test tube top card is spacing on the slick line, cooperation spring extrusion cardboard is fixed the test tube below, prevent that the test tube from rocking to cause the sample to pollute, the device bottom is provided with the vibration damping mount shock attenuation, it is more stable after putting into to make its test tube.

This kind of biological gene save set has seted up the heat conduction hole through internal frame bottom and storage tube bottom and has transmitted the temperature, internal frame outside end is provided with the picture peg card and fixes at device shell inner chamber spacing inslot, leave the interval region on the device shell inner chamber between the spacing groove, keep warm at interval region spare through setting up the heat preservation, the internal frame top is provided with the expansion plate, the expansion plate that sets up through the multisection stretches and inserts the circular slot, the expansion plate expandes seals the internal frame, prevent that inside temperature from running off, it is stronger to make its test tube sample put into the interior back heat preservation ability of storage tube.

FIG. 2 is a schematic cross-sectional view of the front structure of the present invention;

illustration of the drawings: the device comprises a device shell-1, a limiting groove-101, a top cover-2, a hinge-21, a handle-22, a telescopic plate-3, a clamping groove-4, an inserting groove-41, an inner frame-5, a heat insulation layer-51, a temperature guide hole-52, a storage tube-6, a sliding edge-61, a clamping plate-7, a spring-71, a connecting rod-72, a temperature sensor-8 and a damping base-9.

Detailed Description

The technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

Referring to fig. 1-4, a biological gene save set, including device shell 1, device shell 1 top is provided with top cap 2, 2 top fixedly connected with handles 22 of top cap, 2 left sides of top cap articulate there is hinge 21, 2 below of top cap are provided with expansion plate 3, draw-in groove 4 has been seted up on 1 top right side of device shell, 1 bottom fixedly connected with vibration damping mount 9 of device shell, 1 inner chamber of device shell is provided with internal frame 5, be provided with storage tube 6 in the internal frame 5, 6 side fixedly connected with connecting rod 72 of storage tube, 5 below of internal frame are provided with temperature sensor 8, keep warm through 5 both sides fixed connection's of internal frame heat preservation 51, make the inside temperature heat preservation effect of its internal frame 5 better difficult the loss.

As shown in fig. 2, a circular groove is formed in the left side of the clamping groove 4, the right side end of the expansion plate 3 is embedded in the circular groove, the expansion plate 3 is arranged in a multi-section mode, the circular groove is arranged in a semi-circular arc mode, the expansion plate 3 is inserted into the circular groove after being stretched to seal the lower inner frame 5, the temperature loss in the inner frame 5 is prevented, and the heat preservation effect of the expansion plate is better.

As shown in fig. 2, top cap 2 right side bottom is provided with the buckle, and the buckle inserts in draw-in groove 4, and swing joint inserts by 41 in draw-in groove 4, inserts by 41 side and runs through 4 lateral walls of draw-in groove buckle and inlays on draw-in groove 4 inner walls, and the buckle inserts by 41 back in inserting draw-in groove 4 perpendicularly and runs through the buckle and fix it in draw-in groove 4, prevents that the maloperation from opening top cap 2.

As shown in fig. 2, a limiting groove 101 is formed in the side wall of the inner cavity of the device shell 1, a plugboard is fixedly connected to the side end of the inner frame 5, the plugboard is embedded in the limiting groove 101, the limiting groove 101 is arranged in an upper mode and a lower mode, the inner frame 5 is better fixed in the limiting groove 101 through the bottom and the plugboard in the upper mode, and the heat preservation layer 51 is arranged in the upper heat preservation layer and the lower heat preservation layer through the reserved area between the upper limiting groove 101 and the lower limiting groove 101.

As shown in fig. 2, a spacing region is left between the upper and lower parts of the limiting groove 101 on the side wall of the inner cavity of the device shell 1, the heat preservation layer 51 is embedded in the spacing region, and the heat preservation layer 51 is arranged in the spacing region to insulate the inner frame 5, so that the temperature in the inner frame 5 is not easy to lose, and the internal heat preservation effect is better.

As shown in fig. 4, be provided with the slick and sly 61 above the storage tube 6, the slick and sly 61 sets up and encircles on the 6 opening sides of storage tube, the mutual symmetry of slick and sly 61 and sample test tube opening side sets up, it is spacing through opening side cover with the sample test tube on the slick and sly 61, it is more convenient to make its sample test tube go to put, the sample test tube is difficult for taking place to rock at slide 61 internal fixation through inlaying when the device rocks, make its sample test tube more stable in storage tube 6.

As shown in fig. 2, the hole 52 that leads the temperature has all been seted up to internal frame 5 bottom and the 6 bottoms of storage tube, and the hole 52 that leads the temperature of internal frame 5 bottom communicates the hole 52 that leads the temperature of the 6 bottoms of storage tube, makes its temperature transmit back in internal frame 5, leads the temperature hole 52 through the 6 bottoms of storage tube and directly transmits the temperature to the sample test tube and keeps warm, makes its sample test tube keep warm and deposits the effect better.

As shown in fig. 2, fixedly connected with spring 71 on the inner chamber lateral wall of memotron 6, spring 71 side fixedly connected with cardboard 7, and cardboard 7 is provided with two sets of on the inner chamber lateral wall of memotron 6, cardboard 7 is the laminating of convex setting on the sample test tube, it is better to make its fixed effect, through upper and lower two sets of settings, make the high sample test tube of its different models put into the back and fix on the cardboard 7 of different heights, the sample test tube is put into behind memotron 6, will lean on sample test tube to fix with cardboard 7 extrusion through spring 71, make its sample test tube protective effect better.

The above description is only for the preferred embodiment of the present invention, but the scope of the present invention is not limited thereto, and any person skilled in the art should be considered to be within the technical scope of the present invention, and equivalent alternatives or modifications according to the technical solution of the present invention and the inventive concept thereof should be covered by the scope of the present invention.
